sql_templates.description: Fetch latest corporate events with result verdicts and current stage information.
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT ce.symbol, ce.event_date, ce.event_type, ce.purpose_raw, ra.verdict, ra.source_trail, ss.stage
FROM signals.corporate_events AS ce
JOIN scores.results_analysis AS ra ON ce.symbol = ra.symbol
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots AS ss ON ce.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE ce.event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
  AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
ORDER BY ce.event_date DESC
LIMIT 50;

sql_templates.name: insider_bulk_technical_query
sql_templates.query:
WITH insider_signals AS (
    SELECT ia.symbol, ia.alert_date, ia.insider_score
    FROM signals.insider_alerts ia
    WHERE ia.insider_score > 80
),
bulk_deals AS (
    SELECT bbd.symbol, bbd.deal_date
    FROM signals.bulk_block_deals bbd
    WHERE bbd.deal_type = 'BULK_DEAL'
),
latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT 
        s.symbol, s.trading_signal
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots s
    WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
      AND s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
)
SELECT 
    i.symbol, i.alert_date, l.trading_signal
FROM 
    insider_signals i
JOIN 
    bulk_deals b ON i.symbol = b.symbol
JOIN 
    latest_snapshot l ON i.symbol = l.symbol
LIMIT 50;

synthesis_guidance: ['Focus on identifying gaps and exceptions first.', 'Highlight any discrepancies in position sizing context.', 'Correlate technical signals with bulk or insider deal events.']
title: Insider Bulk Deal Signal Review Variant 1368

SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol, s.company_name, s.sector, s.enhanced_fund_score, s.trading_signal, e.close
FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks s
JOIN market.equity_eod e ON s.symbol = e.symbol
WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)

LIMIT 10;
